description: Defines the SetCookie class for handling HTTP cookies, including parsing, validation, and string representation.

classes.name: SetCookie
classes.description: Represents an HTTP Set-Cookie header, providing methods for parsing, validation, and string conversion.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a SetCookie object from a Set-Cookie header string by parsing its components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SetCookie object with provided cookie data, setting defaults and derived values.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the cookie suitable for HTTP headers.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the cookie data as an associative array.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the cookie name.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie value.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the cookie value.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie domain.

methods.name: setDomain
methods.description: Sets the cookie domain.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie path.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the cookie path.

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.description: Retrieves the max-age of the cookie.

methods.name: setMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the max-age of the cookie.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves the expiration timestamp of the cookie.

methods.name: setExpires
methods.description: Sets the expiration timestamp of the cookie.

methods.name: getSecure
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is marked as secure.

methods.name: setSecure
methods.description: Marks the cookie as secure or not.

methods.name: getDiscard
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is a discard/session cookie.

methods.name: setDiscard
methods.description: Sets whether the cookie is a discard/session cookie.

methods.name: getHttpOnly
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is HTTP-only.

methods.name: setHttpOnly
methods.description: Sets the HTTP-only flag for the cookie.

methods.name: matchesPath
methods.description: Determines if the cookie matches a given request path.

methods.name: matchesDomain
methods.description: Determines if the cookie matches a given domain.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the cookie has expired.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the cookie according to RFC 6265, returning true or an error message.
